name: b33_route_v5
what: Waypoints for b33_drive.ps1 (W2DEV) v3.1d, PROPOSED from the DEV rehearsal surveys 1-5 (NOT-PREREG) and the DEV kerb survey v2. DIAGNOSTIC tool input, not evidence; path design for the drive, not a measurement threshold; the official route is fixed only by the B-9 survey addendum on the candidate. A waypoint is [x, y] or [x, y, expected soles z] (sender log frame, measured where given).

provenance.m4: coordinator 2026-10-20 from W2DEV geometry survey v2 (dev_notes/m4_survey, DEV, teleports): the Dog STANDS on the +x north-end kerb top at soles z 113.0 (x +163, y 4450..4505); walking OUTWARD (+x, yaw 0) leaves it: drops 124.9 (y 4450), 111.5 (y 4480), 111.0 (y 4505); walking +y/-y along the kerb did not fall. Approach per research section 5: spawn -> (0,1000) -> (0,2600) -> flight y~2700-3300 -> path x 150..210 north -> kerb. v3: north on the path centre line x 0 from the flight top (0,3300) in legs of ~250 uu to (0,4380), a PRECISE corner east to (100,4380) on the path, then the mount taps NE onto the kerb top to (163,4468). x 0 north of y 3420 has NOT been walked on this build: an obstacle there gives NO-PROGRESS (a safe abort), a drop gives OFF-PATH. v4: the approach continues north on x 0 to (0,4460) (the path's north end, between the kerbs; NOT walked on this build: rehearsal 3 reached (11.5,4409.3) z 95.5), turns east STANDING to (110,4470) and mounts by taps EAST to (148,4476): the actor then already faces ~+x, so the walk-off turn is small and its heading probe converges at once (v3.1c). v5: the centre line north to (0,4375) (walked in rehearsals 3 and 5 to y 4409 / 4427), a standing corner east to (85,4375) (rehearsal 3: (75.7,4368.3) 94.3, (90.5,4376.3) 94.3), then NE onto the strip at its small step to (140,4416) (rehearsal 3's track, above), and the mount taps on the strip top NORTH to mount.to (155,4470): inside the ruled box (x 140..186, y 4450..4505), on the line rehearsal 3 walked (x 153..161 at y 4431..4450) and the DEV kerb survey's x 161, 17 uu west of the walk-off edge guard (x 172). The walk-off turn is ~75-95 deg (the actor faces north after the mount); the v3.1e drive measures the walk-off heading from the Dog's displacement over three 30-ms taps (~7 uu a round), not by turning the actor. NOT walked: x 140..155 at y 4416..4470.

dry_run_terrain.what: A MADE-UP rectangle model used ONLY by -DryRun to exercise the drive's logic offline. NOT the game's geometry; v3 shapes it after rehearsals 1-2 and the kerb survey: the path between raised kerb strips, the strip's east edge at x 195 with a terrace (z 35) and the slab (z -11.8) beyond. v4 adds rehearsal 3's step (z 27.5) and terrace (z 35.6) south-east of the kerb. v5 adds rehearsal 5's trough (z 51) between the path's north end and the strip, the path's lower east lip, and starts the strip at x 118.
